description: Roles of every local dataset considered for the learned context model (audit 2026-10-26). `role`: development = repeatedly examined, never test; examined = touched by v2 tuning/audit, test use supports disjointness only; reference = labels from external curated truth, not yet used to tune; results_only = aggregates, no raw per-candidate rows; unlabelled = no truth; excluded = out by instruction. `genome_level: false` cohorts have no genome layout and cannot enter a genome split table. Counts are quoted from files read on 2026-10-26 (see docs/benchmarks/v3-training-data.md).

datasets.labels: RB-TnSeq fitness-validated exact EC per target protein (positive only; one validated EC per target)
datasets.location: benchmark/manifests/reference_data/ibex_extracted/price149_all6_compact.pkl.gz; whole-proteome matrices on the remote host (root-owned)
gaps: repeatedly examined: cannot be called untouched test
no negative truth: other ECs on a target are unconfirmed, not false
family/cluster map pending
compact artifact has truncated context; full proteome context being prepared by root

datasets.labels: GOA experimental-evidence GO per protein (bench10/truth/*_truth_exp.tsv); all-evidence files are mostly IEA and are not truth

counts.experimental_truth_bytes: vcholerae 46, rprowazekii 25, tpallidum 46, saureus 1125, spneumoniae 1631, ccrescentus 814

gaps: cluster-resident, not verified locally
v2 hyperparameters were retuned during the v2 audit while these genomes were in view
most genomes carry almost no experimental truth
E. coli K-12 is the v2 calibration genome and must not be test

datasets.labels: Kaggle CAFA6 pre-t0 train_terms (537,027 pairs, 82,404 proteins) and a later-snapshot experimental superset reconstruction (562,499 pairs)
gaps: protein-level: no genome layout/operon/assembly context, so context features are unobservable
validation fold is a subset of train
GOA record dates are not first-assertion dates
no homology clusters shipped for a family-disjoint split

datasets.labels: UniProt EC numbers on entries created 2025-02-05 .. 2026-01-28 (model-training cutoff proxy, not annotation time)
gaps: protein-level
227 proteins, 121 organisms: no genome context
EC may be inherited from homologues of older entries

datasets.labels: 50 masked-reaction cases, true protein among top-5 RLGC candidates
gaps: candidate lists are truncated at 5 and pre-ranked by the earlier RLGC stage: cannot teach a null outcome
development set

datasets.labels: aggregate F-max per aspect/bucket (4,712 MF / 5,969 CC / 5,444 BP test proteins)
gaps: no per-protein rows, no raw candidates, t0 and GOA release undefined

datasets.labels: scores computed by the old whole_genome_cafa runner
gaps: each file is a dict of old-runner outputs (per-protein F-max, 184 corrections / 76 regressions, 54,642 score changes, per-GCF summaries), not raw candidate matrices
the 'meteor' arm is the old Python reimplementation; the truth source is not recorded in the file
no candidate-level features or labels can be rebuilt from it

datasets.labels: metadata only; 2,268 rows are eggNOG predictions (not truth), 832 are partial GOA archaeal proteomes (annotated proteins only)
gaps: no sequences or truth for whole genomes
useful only for taxonomy-aware split design
no experimental truth: usable only for unlabelled context features (cohort recurrence), not labels

datasets.labels: Swiss-Prot reviewed proteins with strictly experimental GO (EXP/IDA/IPI/IMP/IGI/IEP/H*) or EC with ECO:0000269, on the exact assemblies of the organisms in benchmark/v3/results/label-rich-selection/selection_manifest.json
datasets.location: selection manifest only; genomes not acquired (assembly mapping unresolved for every organism)
gaps: selection only: no genome, no feature export, no labels table exists yet
20-58 labelled proteins per organism: partial truth, metrics stay on labelled proteins
Swiss-Prot labels are inputs of pretrained predictors: pretrained-model leakage not assessed
Price host organisms not all resolved locally: price_genus_check pending
family/cluster map pending
excluded by instruction
